rules.title: Bend Zone & Hole-Edge Distance Reference (shared by all B_05 rules)
position_resolution: MANDATORY for ALL B_05 rules — resolve hole center before applying bend formula.
Use the same patterns as LC_02 position_resolution:
Pattern A: 'hole at X from edge/corner'       -> center = X from that edge
Pattern C: 'N holes, D apart / distance D'    -> each_center = (face_dim - D) / 2
Pattern D: 'at X from one end, Y from other' -> centers at X and (face_dim - Y)
After resolving: C = hole center measured from the THEORETICAL CORNER (TC).
TC = intersection of the two EXTENDED flat planes at the bend (the virtual sharp corner).
TC is NOT the inner tangent (inner tangent is at r from TC along the face).
TC is the reference used in BendFunction.py: bend_deduction = r+t is subtracted from TC.
If hole is described relative to the FREE edge: C = face_dim - center_from_free_edge
description: outer_bend_zone = bend_radius + thickness  = setback for 90° bend  (default B_02: = 2 x thickness)
This is the distance from TC to where the FLAT ZONE begins on each adjacent face.
FLAT ZONE per face (holes must be placed here):
n_bends=1 (L-wall, L-base, flange of U/Z/CAPOT): flat_zone = face_dim - 1x(r+t)
n_bends=2 (U-base, Z-web, tube face):             flat_zone = face_dim - 2x(r+t)
n_bends=4 (CAPOT base):                           flat_zone_x = dim_x - 2x(r+t)  AND  flat_zone_y = dim_y - 2x(r+t)
EQUIVALENCE with B_03 (hole_to_bend_min for given thickness):
Minimum hole EDGE distance from TC = outer_bend_zone + t = r + 2t  (default r=t: equals 3t)
B_03 hole_to_bend value measured from TC equals r + 2t when default r=t.
When user specifies r explicitly: recalculate outer_bend_zone = r+t accordingly.
All distances from HOLE EDGE (not center): hole_edge = C - R
Bend-side formula: effective_dist = hole_edge - outer_bend_zone = C - R - outer_bend_zone
VIOLATION if effective_dist < thickness

rules.title: Hole to Bend Distance — L-Bracket
description: SCOPE: L-Bracket BASE (1 bend toward wall) | L-Bracket WALL (1 bend toward base).
Free edges (3 per face) -> LC_02.  Bend edge (1) -> this rule.
Bend zone: see B_05_COMMON. outer_bend_zone used in formula.
bend_edge_identification: The BEND EDGE is the fold line shared between the base and the wall.
On the BASE face: the bend edge runs along the LENGTH dimension (bend_along_side).
C = hole center measured from that bend edge toward the FREE edge (opposite side).
On the WALL face: the bend edge runs along the LENGTH dimension at the bottom.
C = hole center measured upward from the bend edge.
When bend edge is ambiguous (user says 'bracket' without specifying which edge bends):
Take the dimension where C-to-C spacing D was given along that axis.
each_center = (face_dim - D) / 2  (smaller value is nearer to one edge).
Apply B_05_L to the SMALLER center value (nearer edge is the more critical bend-side check).
Also apply LC_02 to the same smaller center value treating it as a potential FREE edge.
If EITHER check fails -> report the appropriate violation.
This ensures violation is caught regardless of which edge is BEND vs FREE.
rule: Variables: C = hole_center from TC (Theoretical Corner) of the bend edge, R = diameter/2, t = thickness
hole_edge = C - R
effective_dist = hole_edge - outer_bend_zone  (outer_bend_zone = bend_radius + t)
VIOLATION if effective_dist < t
Multiple holes: check each independently.
EXAMPLE: C, D, t given. R=D/2, outer_bend_zone=2t (default).
effective = C - D/2 - 2t  ->  OK if C - D/2 >= 3t
FOR RECTANGLE CUTOUTS (use edge of rectangle, not center):
C_perp = hole center distance from bend TC, perpendicular to fold line
half_perp = rect_dim_perpendicular_to_fold / 2
cutout_edge = C_perp - half_perp
effective_dist = cutout_edge - outer_bend_zone
VIOLATION if effective_dist < t
FOR OBLONG CUTOUTS (long axis parallel to fold):
C_perp = hole center from TC, perpendicular to fold
half_perp = W_ob / 2  (W_ob = oblong width = shorter dimension, perpendicular to fold)
cutout_edge = C_perp - half_perp
effective_dist = cutout_edge - outer_bend_zone
VIOLATION if effective_dist < t
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance between the hole and the inner bend be at least {{hole_to_bend_min from B_03 table}}mm. Would you like to continue or modify?

rules.title: Hole to Bend Distance — U-Bracket
description: SCOPE:
BASE   : 2 bend sides along dim_x (left+right flanges). Free: dim_y front/back -> LC_02.
FLANGE : 1 bend side at bottom. Free: top + 2 lateral -> LC_02.
Bend zone: see B_05_COMMON. outer_bend_zone used in formula.
rule: BASE — W=dim_x, C=hole_center from LEFT TC (Theoretical Corner), R=diameter/2, t=thickness:
hole_edge = C - R
effective_near = hole_edge - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
effective_far  = (W - C - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
VIOLATION if either < t
FLANGE — C_z=hole_center height from BOTTOM TC (Theoretical Corner):
effective = (C_z - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t  ->  VIOLATION if < t
Multiple holes: check each independently.
EXAMPLE (BASE, centered hole): C=W/2, outer_bend_zone=2t
effective_near = effective_far = W/2 - R - 2t  ->  OK if W/2 - R >= 3t
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance between the hole and the inner bend be at least {{hole_to_bend_min from B_03 table}}mm. Would you like to continue or modify?

rules.title: Hole to Bend Distance — Z-Bracket
description: SCOPE — 3 faces, each with a different bend count:
TOP FLANGE : 1 bend edge at bottom (toward web). Free: top + 2 lateral -> LC_02.
WEB        : 2 bend edges — top (toward top_flange) + bottom (toward bot_flange). Free: 2 lateral -> LC_02.
BOT FLANGE : 1 bend edge at top (toward web). Free: bottom + 2 lateral -> LC_02.
Flat zones: top_flange = top_length - 1x(r+t) | web = horizontal_length - 2x(r+t) | bot_flange = bottom_length - 1x(r+t)
Bend zone: see B_05_COMMON. outer_bend_zone used in formula.
rule: TOP FLANGE — H_top=top_length, C=hole_center from BOTTOM TC (toward web), R=diameter/2, t=thickness:
effective = (C - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t  ->  VIOLATION if < t
WEB — H=horizontal_length, C=hole_center from TOP TC (toward top_flange), R=diameter/2, t=thickness:
effective_near = (C - R) - outer_bend_zone       >=  t   (check: top bend side)
effective_far  = (H - C - R) - outer_bend_zone   >=  t   (check: bottom bend side)
VIOLATION if either < t
BOT FLANGE — H_bot=bottom_length, C=hole_center from TOP TC (toward web), R=diameter/2, t=thickness:
effective = (C - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t  ->  VIOLATION if < t
Multiple holes: check each independently.
EXAMPLE (WEB, centered hole): H=horizontal_length, C=H/2, outer_bend_zone=2t (default r=t)
effective_near = effective_far = H/2 - R - 2t  ->  OK if H/2 - R >= 3t
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance between the hole and the inner bend be at least {{hole_to_bend_min from B_03 table}}mm. Would you like to continue or modify?

rules.title: Hole to Bend Distance — Tube-Rectangular
description: SCOPE: Tube bent from sheet. Each face: 2 bend sides in face_width direction (cross-section corners).
Free edges: 2 tube-end openings (length direction) -> LC_02.
face_width W = tube outer cross-section width.  t = wall_thickness.
Bend zone: see B_05_COMMON. outer_bend_zone used in formula.
rule: Variables: W=face_width, C=hole_center from left inner corner, R=diameter/2, t=wall_thickness
hole_edge = C - R
effective_near = hole_edge - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
effective_far  = (W - C - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
VIOLATION if either < t
Multiple holes: check each independently.
EXAMPLE (centered hole): C=W/2, outer_bend_zone=2t
effective = W/2 - R - 2t  ->  OK if W/2 - R >= 3t  (i.e., W >= diameter + 6t)
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance between the hole and the inner bend corner be at least {{hole_to_bend_min from B_03 table}}mm on both sides. Would you like to continue or modify?

rules.title: Hole to Bend Distance — CAPOT/Cover Box
description: SCOPE:
BASE : 4 bend sides (all edges to walls). 0 free edges -> LC_02 NOT applied to base.
WALL : 1 bend side at bottom. Free: top + 2 lateral -> LC_02.
Bend zone: see B_05_COMMON. outer_bend_zone used in formula.
rule: BASE — 2-sided check on X-axis AND Y-axis independently:
X: W_x=capot_length, C_x=hole_center from front inner corner, R=diameter/2, t=thickness
effective_near_x = (C_x - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
effective_far_x  = (W_x - C_x - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
Y: W_y=capot_width,  C_y=hole_center from left inner corner
effective_near_y = (C_y - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
effective_far_y  = (W_y - C_y - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t
VIOLATION if any of the 4 checks < t
WALL — C_z=hole_center height from bottom inner corner:
effective = (C_z - R) - outer_bend_zone  >=  t  ->  VIOLATION if < t
Multiple holes: check each independently.
EXAMPLE (BASE, centered hole): C_x=W_x/2, C_y=W_y/2, outer_bend_zone=2t
all 4 checks = W_axis/2 - R - 2t  ->  OK if min(W_x,W_y)/2 - R >= 3t
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance between the hole and the nearest inner bend be at least {{hole_to_bend_min from B_03 table}}mm. Would you like to continue or modify?

rules.title: Minimum Z-Bend Counter Bend Distance
rules.rule: z_bend_distance >= z_bend_dist value from B_03 table
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** We recommend that the minimum distance against bends be at least equal to {{z_bend_dist from B_03}}. Do you want to continue or modify?
